description: This PHP script handles adding or modifying a device in the inventory list within the TestLink project. It initializes required parameters, checks user permissions, interacts with the tlInventory class to set inventory data, and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure along with user feedback.

classes.name: tlInventory
classes.description: A class responsible for managing inventory items, including setting inventory data, providing user feedback, and current data retrieval.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments from the request, returning a structured object with parameters related to inventory devices.
